City is reporting participant, not a universal asset owner. Section 2.2.1 describes both owned and jointly owned/interconnection facilities.
All costs, savings, windows, coordinates, geometry and accuracy remain unknown; named facilities are context only.
Retain raw MVA/Circuit and source spellings; do not turn a circuit ordinal into a project count.
Some KUA substation expansions may serve distribution but do not explicitly say so in this table; preserve that classification uncertainty.
No explicit cross-source links observed; independent identities, no name-based deduplication.
Public source availability does not imply a public-reuse license; original remains ignored.
